text:
Hello everyone! 😊
I'm looking for a job opportunity for my husband. We live in Israel city Migdal ha Emek , and he recently received a B/1 work visa through our family reunification process.

He is from Kenya and is hardworking, reliable, and eager to work. At the moment, he doesn't speak Hebrew yet so many places dont take him, so we're looking for a workplace where English is enough while he continues learning Hebrew.

If you know of any job openings or employers looking for a dedicated worker, please let me know or send me a private message. We'd really appreciate any recommendations or shares.

Thank you so much for your help! ❤️
